latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of image-and-text-to-video.

- Instantly creates 1080p MP4 promo videos from uploaded images and text prompts, supporting JPG, PNG, WEBP, and GIF files up to 200MB.
- Connects to a cloud AI video rendering pipeline; setup is automatic and completed in seconds.
- Supports core actions: upload files, check credit balance, preview project state, and export finished videos.
- Clear prompt-based workflow allows for fast, descriptive editing, from quick edits to iterative timeline updates.
- Handles common errors (file size/type, credits, session/token issues) with clear, actionable messages.
